title: Components and signs of the ordinary bounded dual and bidual
statement:
Let $(C,J,R)$ be a small ringed site with commutative coefficient sheaf under [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $E$ be a cochain complex of $R$-module sheaves, with $E^i=0$ for $i<a$ or $b<i$, where $a,b\in\mathbf Z$. Put $O=R[0]$, $D=\mathcal Hom_R^\bullet(E,O)$, and $D'=\mathcal Hom_R^\bullet(D,O)$ using [def-pur-hom-complex], and write $T^\vee=\mathcal Hom_R(T,R)$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. Projection to the unique possibly nonzero factor gives canonical isomorphisms
$$D^q\cong(E^{-q})^\vee,\qquad (D')^i\cong((E^i)^\vee)^\vee.$$
Under them,
$$d_D^q(\phi)=(-1)^{q+1}\phi d_E^{-q-1},\qquad d_{D'}^i=-(d_E^i)^{\vee\vee},$$
and $D^q=0$ for $q<-b$ or $-a<q$. The homogeneous formula $x\mapsto(\phi\mapsto(-1)^{|x||\phi|}\phi(x))$ defines a chain map $\beta:E\to D'$; its degree-$i$ component, under the displayed identification, is $(-1)^i\delta_{E^i}$, where $\delta_T(t)(\phi)=\phi(t)$. These identifications and formulas hold for arbitrary $E$ with the stated bound, with no finite-free retract or exactness assumption on its terms.
